answers.core:
Mostly full ISO 639-3 compliance and to make it so a addon wouldn't be needed for a seamless workflow.

Also you guys have eo (Esperanto) support, and Toki Pona is pretty popular in that community.
answers.workaround: Not implementing Toki Pona "tok" will be *okay*, but the user would need to use a incorrect ISO code, eg. ang, or tpi (Toki Pisin), which isn't really that great of a practice.

title: Add ISO 639-3 Code "tok" (Toki Pona) to engine for Translation support.
